title: Factor the translated Hessian and retain the induction remainder
statement: For lambda(A)=[3ell(k|A1|^2-|A2|^2)+24k det A]/(2m),d_ij=A_i dot E_j,c_ij=det(A_i,E_j), set L1=c12+c21-3k d11-3d22;L2=ell(kd11-d22)+(5k+1)(c12-c21);L3=d12+c22+k c11+d21;L4=d12+c22-k c11-d21. EXACT D2J_k(A)[E,E]-2lambda(A)det E=ell L1^2/(4m)+3L2^2/(4nm)+3ell L3^2/(4m)+ell^2 L4^2/(4nm), all coefficients positive. The producer reports a separate denominator-cleared zero-polynomial check; Capital does not replay it. With constant A, integrated det G vanishes and H_G[A,A]=int|S(A,G)|^2. In an axis-conditional split G=X(x2)+V with mean_x1 V=0, the mixed cubic includes int S(A,V).S(X,V)+int Dlambda(A)[X]det V. Available completion leaves int DJ_k(V):X+int[Dlambda(A)[X]+lambda(X)]det V. This coefficient is nonconstant: constant-mean quasiconvexity cannot be applied at A+X(x2). Four Hessian squares therefore do not establish original supporting/Jensen inequality.
